title.jcr:title: Got questions? We have the answer

question.jcr:title: What are the options available to host a generated output?

answer.text: Output generated in RoboHelp can be hosted on any web enabled server like Apache, RoboHelp Server, SharePoint Online, Zendesk Help Center, Salesforce Knowledge Base, ServiceNow Knowledge Base, Zoho Knowledge Base, and Adobe Experience Manager.

question.jcr:title: How to use Review and where it is hosted? Is an Adobe Id required to access it?

answer.text: To collaborate using Review, log in using your Adobe ID as Review is hosted on the Adobe Creative Cloud. For more information, view Review and Collaboration.

question.jcr:title: How can I collaborate with other authors?

answer.text: Collaborate with other authors for creating, sharing, and managing reviews for your content using Git, SharePoint online, and Azure DevOps.

question.jcr:title: What are the supported file formats in RoboHelp?

answer.text: RoboHelp supports a wide range of file formats for both opening existing Help projects and importing content from other authoring tools. This includes project formats like HHP, XPJ, and MPJ, as well as import formats such as Word, PDF, FrameMaker, DITA, HTML/XML, and various image, audio, and video files. For more information, view Supported file formats.

question.jcr:title: I want to upgrade my project. What are the points that I must keep in mind?

answer.text: To upgrade your project from RoboHelp Classic to reimagined version (2019 release or 2020 release), there are certain points to consider which might occur due to the upgrade. For more information, view Upgrade a project in RoboHelp.
Learn how to resolve download issues with RoboHelp and other Adobe apps.

question.jcr:title: Can I get a trial version of RoboHelp? Also, how can I check for and install RoboHelp updates?

answer.text: Yes. You can download a fully functional, 30-day complimentary trial version by signing in with an Adobe ID and password. For detailed instructions, view installing a trial. To check if there are any updates, go to Help > Check for Updates in your current version of RoboHelp. Alternately, you can also manually install them from downloads.

question.jcr:title: Why am I getting an error to "Update OS or Browser" while installing or activating RoboHelp?

answer.text: All Adobe products recommend using the latest Operating System and browser updates to function efficiently. If you are running the latest updates and still facing the error, then for more help view deprecated IE10 support. Also, take a look at upgrading operating system and supported browser versions.

question.jcr:title: Can I install RoboHelp on another computer?

answer.text: You can install RoboHelp on up to two computers. If you want to install it on a third computer, you need to deactivate it on one of your previous machines. Learn more about activating and deactivating Adobe apps. If you need five or more licenses, consider purchasing a volume licensing plan.

question.jcr:title: How can I create and distribute Adobe RoboHelp package through Adobe Admin Console?

answer.text: Pre-defined templates are available in the Admin Console to create packages for Adobe RoboHelp. For more details, view Adobe Templates for Packages.

question.jcr:title: How can I change my password?

answer.text: Sign in to your Adobe account. Under the Password section, select Change for Current Password, and then follow the onscreen instructions. Forgot your password? Learn how to reset it.

question.jcr:title: How can I change my credit card info?

answer.text: You can update your credit card information from your accounts page on adobe.com. For more information, view Payment in the Adobe Store | Online order and payment FAQ.

question.jcr:title: My trial expires soon. How do I renew it?

answer.text: You can convert the 30-day trial version of Adobe RoboHelp into a subscription by purchasing a license from Adobe.com. For any queries, you can reach us at techcomm@adobe.com. For more information, see Subscription information and pricing in the RoboHelp FAQ.

question.jcr:title: How do I cancel my subscription? Can I still use the software I have?

answer.text: You can cancel your subscription by contacting Adobe Support. If you cancel within 14 days, you receive a full refund. Otherwise, you are billed 50% of your remaining contract obligation. You will not have access to your subscription software after you cancel. For more information, view Subscription information and pricing in the RoboHelp FAQ.

question.jcr:title: How can I manage my licenses if they are allocated through my organization?

answer.text: You can get in touch with your Administrator who manages licenses for your organization. In case you need more assistance, then your Administrator can raise a ticket in the Admin Console.
